Personal memento: Lucite from first $500M deal(funded Stratos Aerospace) on desk.

Active transactions:
- $8.5B semiconductor merger: QuantumChip Technologies & Silicon Core – navigating U.S.-China regulatory approvals(masterclass in patience and strategy)

- Confidential $5B+ cross-border renewable energy acquisition: Solaris Energy Group acquiring Nordic Renewables – aligning government incentives across jurisdictions is a major hurdle

Weekly deal call: Every Monday at 7 AM to accommodate Asian market participants – keeps the MD sharp

Potential $20B take-private: Omnix AI(AI powerhouse) – if successful, would be a game-changer for the firm.

Career journey:
- 2001: Analyst at Goldman Sachs – cut teeth on M&A modeling, survived dot-com crash
- 2004: Associate at Morgan Stanley – exposure to early social media tech deals
- 31: Vice President – led defining transactions of that era
- 2015: Joined Legend Investments as Managing Director – first major transaction: NeuralNet Systems IPO(largest tech IPO to date)

Core insight: In global finance, network and track record are currency. Trust is earned one successful deal at a time.

Education & impact:
- B.A. in Economics, University of Pennsylvania
- MBA from Harvard Business School(Baker Scholar)
- Guest lecturer, mentor, and talent recruiter at both institutions
- Endowed a scholarship at Penn for first-generation college students in finance

Belief: Talent is the greatest investment. Finance should be a pathway to opportunity—not just for the privileged, but for those with hunger and discipline.
